lines.text: Mom hit the roof when she saw the mess.

data.define: Used when someone suddenly becomes very angry.

example.text: Mom hit the roof when she saw the mess.

misuse.text: Don't say 'hit the roof' when mildly annoyed.

publish.title: What does "hit the roof" mean?
publish.value: Hit the roof = Get very angry. Example: "Mom hit the roof when she saw the mess." (casual English).
